reference.note: Pinned Code-OSS capture and a real Alula Windows desktop capture are preserved. Both use 1505x1005 physical pixels, 1204x804 logical viewport, 1.25 scale, and dark theme. The Alula UI is zh-CN while the pinned reference is en-US; label-level visual comparison is deferred to P05.

fixtures.case: Edit Cargo.toml, edit src/main.rs, then undo once in each document.
fixtures.sourceInspection: One UndoStack belongs to _WorkbenchPageState and snapshots contain no document identity.
fixtures.expectedCurrentObservation: Each active document receives the other document's snapshot.
fixtures.evidence: flutter test app/test/p00_risk_fixtures_test.dart --reporter expanded; full init.sh replay

fixtures.case: Accept 2,000,001 UTF-16 units in a dirty file, let the journal flush, then recreate the workbench.
fixtures.expectedCurrentObservation: The journal has no edited body; restoration reads the saved disk text.
fixtures.evidence: flutter test app/test/p00_risk_fixtures_test.dart --reporter expanded; full init.sh replay

fixtures.case: Start a workspace LSP, attach one document, close that document, then inspect the process.
fixtures.sourceInspection: alula_doc_close detaches the document; workspace_servers retains an Arc<LspServer>.
fixtures.expectedCurrentObservation: The LSP child remains alive after all workspace documents close.

fixtures.case: Ask the fake provider for completion with a 1,200 ms response delay and measure caller wait.
fixtures.sourceInspection: LspServer::completion synchronously waits for the response or timeout; Dart invokes it synchronously through FFI.
fixtures.expectedCurrentObservation: The caller remains blocked for approximately the provider delay.

referenceBehavior.mode: --disable-extensions; isolated user-data and extensions directories; CDP on port 9223
referenceBehavior.operation: Append one character to Cargo.toml and src/main.rs separately, save, switch between documents, undo once in each, save, compare with each original file.
referenceBehavior.note: This paired run confirms per-document undo history. The other three runtime fixtures are Alula characterization only; no reference-side provider was installed to impersonate a default LSP.

followUpComparisons: The Alula page capture is zh-CN while the pinned Code-OSS capture is en-US; matched-locale label/text visual comparison belongs to P05.
Code-OSS pairing for recovery, process shutdown, and delayed provider remains a later comparative check. P00.3 already has the required Alula characterization baselines for all four cases.
